_comment: Maps TapGuard's 3 wallet operations to MCP tool names + arguments. Defaults match scripts/fake_tangem_mcp.py. On the night: run scripts/inspect_mcp.py against Tangem's MCP and edit the tool names/args here. Placeholders: {to} {amount} {token} {chain} {kind} {memo} {limit}. A placeholder on its own keeps its type (numbers stay numbers); null values are dropped.
